title: Slow response from gearbox and keyless access
summary: The topic combines complaints about delayed drivetrain response during low-speed manoeuvres with a separate mention of slow keyless unlock and boot opening, while several fragments are too incomplete to interpret reliably.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe slow gearbox response that delays acceleration and jerky low-speed manoeuvring that feels awkward when parking.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention slow reactions or creeping slowly, but the short wording does not provide enough context to judge the experience consistently.

limitations: This cluster mixes at least two subjects, drivetrain behaviour and keyless/boot opener response, so it is not fully coherent.
Several fragments are very short or incomplete, which limits reliable interpretation.
The examples are few and stratified, so they do not show how common any issue is beyond these sampled fragments.
